blocks.orig: Asanja Nyasarori is a luxury tented camp in the Western Serengeti – a 20-minute drive from Grumeti Airstrip. The camp has seven ensuite huts and a two-bedroom family hut, all inspired by traditional Maasai Enkaji (home). Each of these rounded huts has a private plunge pool, a separate lounge area, and a bathroom with a hot shower. The camp lets you choose between two single beds or one double bed, with private dining available in each unit. The open woodlands (famous for large herds of elephants!) surrounding the camp add to the secluded and peaceful atmosphere.
blocks.html: Asanja Nyasarori, a luxury tented camp, lies in the Western Serengeti – a drive of 20 minutes from Grumeti Airstrip. Its seven ensuite huts and two-bedroom family hut all take their inspiration from the traditional Maasai Enkaji (home). Each round hut has its own plunge pool, a bathroom with a hot shower and a separate place to lounge. You can opt for a double bed or two singles, and every unit offers the option of dining privately. Open woodlands surround the camp, famous for big elephant herds, and they make it feel secluded and peaceful.
